description: Single-thread dependent pointer chase with primed entry: optional clock/cache warmer, untimed capped chain primer, then one timed chase. The primer remains when the warmer is disabled, including trace capture. Reports effective timed/primer accesses and primed entry identity; derive ns/access from raw GPU event time downstream. Cache-level hits and misses require target qualification; a separate primer does not guarantee L1 residency.

scaling_param.name: array_bytes
scaling_param.description: Array size in bytes; sweeps the dependent chase footprint across target cache capacities

non_scaling_params.name: cacheline_bytes
non_scaling_params.description: Configured byte spacing between chase nodes; qualify physical cache-line/sector size on the target

non_scaling_params.name: measure_laps
non_scaling_params.description: Requested timed laps after the untimed primer; effective accesses are clamped to the documented floor/ceiling

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the clock/cache warmer BEFORE the untimed pointer-chase primer. False skips only the warmer. The timed chase always follows the primer: an explicit resident-cache entry exception.
